The function must return inclusive contiguous ranges from the input values. It must sort without mutating the input, remove duplicate values, merge adjacent integers, preserve negative values, and return `[]` for empty input. For example, `[4, 2, 3, 9, 9, 10]` returns `[[2, 4], [9, 10]]`, while `[-2, -1, 1]` returns `[[-2, -1], [1, 1]]`. Write the implementation and a focused test; do not touch other files.

{"name": "write_file", "arguments": {"path": "src/format/compactRanges.ts", "content": "export function compactRanges(values: number[]): Array<[number, number]> {
  if (values.length === 0) return [];

  const sorted = [...new Set(values)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const ranges: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  let start = sorted[0];
  let end = sorted[0];

  for (const value of sorted.slice(1)) {
    if (value === end + 1) {
      end = value;
    } else {
      ranges.push([start, end]);
      start = value;
      end = value;
    }
  }
  ranges.push([start, end]);
  return ranges;
}
"}}

    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return False
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return 1 <= value <= 65535
    if isinstance(value, str):

import (
    "fmt"
    "strconv"
    "strings"
)

func ParseCoordinate(raw string) (lat float64, lon float64, err error) {
    fields := strings.Split(raw, ",")
    if len(fields) != 2 {
        return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("coordinate must contain latitude and longitude")
    }
    lat, err = strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(fields[0]), 64)
    if err != nil || lat < -90 || lat > 90 {
        return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid latitude")
    }
    lon, err = strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(fields[1]), 64)
    if err != nil || lon < -180 || lon > 180 {
        return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid longitude")
    }
    return lat, lon, nil
}

declare(strict_types=1);

function previewDiscount(array $payload, callable $findCustomer): array
{
    $id = $payload['customer_id'] ?? null;
    if (!is_int($id) || $id <= 0) {
        return ['status' => 422, 'body' => ['error' => 'invalid_customer_id']];
    }

    $customer = $findCustomer($id);
    if ($customer === null) {
        return ['status' => 404, 'body' => ['error' => 'customer_not_found']];
    }

    return [
        'status' => 200,
        'body' => ['customer_id' => $id, 'eligible' => (bool) $customer['active']],
    ];
}
"}}
